headline: BEI Partners with KPEI to Ease Debt Securities Transactions
summary: The Indonesia Stock Exchange is integrating its SPPA system with KPEI's tri-party repo agent to make repo transactions more efficient. The step supports deeper financial markets.
why: Repo markets provide short-term funding and collateral management, which are central to bond market liquidity.
original_headline: BEI Gandeng KPEI, Permudah Transaksi Surat Utang
